_note: The Glory of Rome launcher icon, for both stores. 512 is the largest any Retro Diffusion style will produce; Apple needs exactly 1024, so the 512 is doubled to 1024 with nearest-neighbour (each pixel becomes a 2x2 block) -- Dan approved that doubling on 2026-09-21, for this asset only. No crop, no filtering, no compositing. The icon must be OPAQUE: Apple rejects an icon with an alpha channel, so the background is generated as a solid field rather than removed. run01 used rd_plus__no_style, which the API marks internal-use-only and refused (inference_failed, no charge); rd_plus__environment is the only other style that reaches 512.
